Sportiqo, and I have to say, the experience exceeded my expectations. The instructors are not only highly skilled but also incredibly patient and encouraging, which made learning so much easier and more enjoyable.

Whether you're a complete beginner or just looking to refine your strokes, the program is well-structured to cater to all levels. I particularly appreciated the clear, step-by-step instruction and the focus on safety and technique.

The facilities are clean and well-maintained, with warm water and good changing room amenities. The overall atmosphere is friendly and motivating, making it easy to stay committed and have fun while learning.

Highly recommend Sportiqo for anyone looking to improve their swimming skills in a supportive and professional environment!

We are absolutely delighted with our experience at The Kids Company Colaba. From the moment we walked through the doors, we knew this was the perfect environment for our child (Amara) to grow, learn, and thrive. The warm and welcoming atmosphere created by the dedicated staff makes every child feel at home.

The teachers & principal Ms Vibhuti /Ms Heena and Ms Kavita are not only highly skilled but also incredibly nurturing. They go above and beyond to ensure each child receives personalized attention and care. Our child has flourished under their guidance, developing both socially and academically in ways we could have only hoped for.

The curriculum is thoughtfully designed to balance play and learning, fostering creativity, curiosity, and a love for exploration. The wide range of activities, from arts and crafts to outdoor play, field trips, boat rides & Montessori learning method of education ensures that every day is filled with fun and discovery. Moreover, the facilities are clean, safe, and equipped with age-appropriate resources that enhance the learning experience. We particularly appreciate the frequent communication from the school, keeping us informed and involved in our child’s progress.

We highly recommend “The Kids Company Colaba” to any parent seeking a nurturing, stimulating, and supportive environment for their child’s early education. This school has truly been a second home for our family, and we are grateful for the positive impact it has had on our child’s (Amara) development.

100% recommended.

Soccer Schools of Excellence (SSE), estd 2010 is a dedicated football academy for kids from ages 3 to 18 years located in Mumbai. We work with grounds, schools and residential complexes to provide age appropriate football training.
SSE BFC Soccer Schools is our flagship program with our partners Bengaluru FC Soccer Schools in Mumbai and other cities Pan India.
SSE BFC is an All India Football Federation (AIFF) Accredited academy that runs weekly high quality Elite training programs and camps ( U7s to U17s) with player pathways to Bengaluru FC's residential programs.

featured_reviews.name: Sonal Chopra
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a parent of a Grade 7 student at Orchids The International School, PalaGaly , I have to say the trip to Monteria Village was an absolute hit and a resounding success. The organization was flawless, making for a stress-free and truly enjoyable day out.
The village theme is genuinely captivating. It struck a perfect balance between being an incredibly fun, engaging escape and a surprisingly educational experience for the children. My son and their friends absolutely reveled in the traditional village setting and the unique activities offered. It was a fantastic way for them to step away from the usual routine and embrace something different.

featured_reviews.name: ummesulaim qureshi
featured_reviews.review_text: As a Grade 10 parent, I am extremely satisfied with the Sports Department at Orchids The International School - PalaGaly. My child's progress has been remarkable! The coaches employ excellent methodologies, focusing on discipline, competitive spirit, and advanced athletic conditioning rather than just rote training. The regular fitness assessments and focused training for specific events have helped my child not only grasp difficult techniques but also develop a genuine enthusiasm for a healthy, balanced lifestyle. It's clear that the department is dedicated to ensuring every student is well-prepared and confident for their physical fitness tests and maintaining focus during board exam preparation. Keep up the brilliant work!

featured_reviews.name: Asif Khan
featured_reviews.review_text: As a Grade 10 parent, I am extremely satisfied with the Social Studies Department at Orchids The International School - PalaGaly. My child's progress has been remarkable! The teachers employ excellent teaching methodologies, focusing on in-depth analysis, historical context, and current affairs relevance rather than just rote learning. The regular interactive discussions, map work, and case studies have helped my child not only grasp difficult topics but also develop a genuine enthusiasm for the subject. It's clear that the department is dedicated to ensuring every student is well-prepared and confident for their board exams. Keep up the brilliant work!

featured_reviews.name: Nexyonbags
featured_reviews.review_text:
WOW! I'm blown away by the incredible progress my child has made in sports! The rigorous training and practice have been truly transformative, and I've seen a significant improvement in their skills, confidence, and teamwork.

The coaches and trainers have been absolute rockstars, providing personalized attention and guidance to help my child reach new heights. The emphasis on discipline, hard work, and sportsmanship has been fantastic, and I'm grateful to see my child developing these essential life skills.

The sports program has not only improved my child's physical fitness but also boosted their self-esteem and mental toughness. I'm over the moon with their progress and excited to see them continue to shine on the field!

A huge thank you to the entire sports team for their dedication, expertise, and support. We couldn't be happier with the experience!

featured_reviews.name: Jaffer Habiya
featured_reviews.review_text: We feel confident our child is safe and supported at Orchids The International School. The staff is responsive to our concerns and needs. The school prioritizes student well-being, which is a top priority for us. The school fosters a strong sense of community among parents and students. Communication between teachers and parents is excellent. We're impressed with the school's transparency and openness. The school encourages our child to explore their interests and passions. Our child has developed confidence and independence at school. The school helps students develop essential life skills.

featured_reviews.name: Satya Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: Khel Utsav has been a fantastic initiative, providing a wonderful platform for students to showcase their sporting talents! The special focus on sports has not only promoted physical fitness but also instilled values like teamwork, discipline, and perseverance. We're impressed by the enthusiasm and energy of the students and teachers alike. Congratulations on organizing such a successful event – it's truly inspiring to see the spirit of sportsmanship thriving!

featured_reviews.name: Sarita Sawardekar
featured_reviews.review_text: The school’s music program is truly impressive and plays a vital role in shaping children’s creativity. It provides wonderful opportunities for students to explore singing, rhythm, and instrumental skills. The music sessions are interactive and enjoyable, allowing every child to participate with enthusiasm. Teachers encourage students to express themselves confidently through performances and group activities. I have seen my child develop a strong sense of rhythm and appreciation for different kinds of music. The program not only enhances their musical abilities but also boosts their confidence and teamwork. It’s heartwarming to see how music has become an integral part of their overall learning experience. The school truly deserves appreciation for nurturing such artistic talent among the students.

featured_reviews.name: Jyoti Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text: As a parent of a Grade 7 student at Orchids The International School - Palagaly, I am particularly delighted with the Science Department and its approach to middle school science. The transition from general science to foundational concepts in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology is handled exceptionally well. The teachers make learning highly engaging and exploratory, encouraging a genuine sense of curiosity through hands-on experiments and interactive demonstrations in the labs. They don't just teach facts; they focus on the 'why' and 'how,' which is vital for building a strong base. This approach has significantly boosted my child's analytical skills and made complex topics accessible and fun. I truly commend the Science Department for fostering a love for scientific inquiry.

name: Diamond Jubilee High School for Girls, Mumbai
description:
The Diamond Jubilee High School for Girls is a place where quality education meets nurturing and innovation. As an all-girls’ school, the School recognizes the value of the overall development of girls for the benefit of the larger community. Our students learn not only from our educational programmes but also from our various extra-curricular activities. Moreover, the School building has been designated as a heritage structure.

The school is recognised by the Maharashtra State Education Department and follows the curriculum of the state education board. We offer classes from nursery to high-school level in English medium and serve over 1000 girl students in the South Mumbai area.
